notes.title: Update 0.8
notes.content:
Features
Knight has been added to the roster and can be unlocked by destroying the Celestial Angel.

Rewards can now sometimes show up already upgraded. The chances of an upgraded reward increase with act number.
Bugfixes
Fixed some positive status effects counting as debuffs.

The Workshop no longer incorrectly displays a Wanted Level > 10

Fixed a bug where a Universe Seed equipped to something other than a player would contribute to the battle reward count.

Fixed a bug where a Mirror's Edge clone that dies while equipped with Divide and Conquer would transfer the player's control over to the Divide and Conquer drone even though the player hasn't died.

Fixed a bug where Outlaw Munitions would not work when equipped to a clone deployed by Mirror's Edge.

Munitions Belt no longer counts non-gun weapons in its calculations.

Arsenal X and Munitions Belt now properly highlight guns.

Omni Hangar artwork has been rotated when equipped on the ship.

notes.title: Knight is arriving on September 26th!
notes.content:
Wield Your Blade
The Knight is our premier melee ship, boasting a large arsenal of melee weapons, as well as the powerful Stances. You can only equip one Stance at a time, but each one transforms your gameplay in completely new ways.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/4f6b646040cd1c42e8e252ae9d2785ba815d7b92.png"]


Blazing Comet
In order to get close and deal damage, the Knight needs ways to survive hits. Thankfully, it has plenty of options, such as the Momentum mechanic, which allows you to charge into enemies while tanking hits.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/6b0592996de9a002a3d3f05d40078eb7fadfc426.png"]
Unstoppable Light
Damage isn't the only thing to watch out for. With the new Light resource, Knight can even shrug off incoming status effects as well, allowing it to charge undeterred into enemies.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/2987ceb93ada876163b97269fb50c71540e4dd99.png"]

notes.title: Patch 0.7.7
notes.content:
Improved the game's startup time.
Fixed a bug where the game would sometimes not detect when a teammate switches their ship.
Fixed Honed not actually preventing the gun from gaining fire rate.
Acceleration Core no longer has Honed.

notes.title: Patch 0.7.6
notes.content:
Re-enabled a previously disabled faction
 Fixed a bug that was preventing players from seeing their teammates' Modifiers in multiplayer
 Fixed a bug where Wanted Level would activate reinforcements on lower difficulty levels.

notes.title: Patch 0.7.5
notes.content:
Removed some tags that appeared in the text of certain items instead of as tags attached to the item.
Fixed a crash preventing the players from beating the game.

notes.title: Update 0.7
notes.content:
Features
We have now added visible tags to the game! Tags were already in use for various interactions, but they are now displayed on items for full clarity. There might still be some missing or unusual tags though, as we're still cleaning things up.

Vulture has been added to the game and can be unlocked by beating the game on Ace.
Balance
The Virtual Reaper's minimum distance has been increased. It should no longer be able to touch the player, and thus correctly prevents the bullets inside from hitting the player.

The enemy hangars that deploy Reflection Drones now have a deploy limit of 1.

Enemy Repair Beams can no longer target ships with Healer AI.

The Eon now disperses in all directions at the start of the fight instead of rushing at the player.
Forge
Forge landed in a strong spot, particularly because of its multiplicative nature which turns effects that were normally balanced into unstoppable swarms. This update aims to reduce its multiplicative powers while giving back power in other areas.

Hangar Volley now fires Mini Missiles, which are faster and deal less damage. (50 -> 10)

Hangar Volley cooldown reduced 9 -> 6

Assembly Line changed: Hangars in this column have [strike]+1 multishot[/strike] +64% fire rate and +1 deploy limit.

Heavy Augment no longer increases hangar deploy limits.

All Cores have their cooldowns reduced 12 -> 10

All Cores now have the Honed tag. (When this is upgraded, increase damage instead of fire rate)

Doomsday Core changed: Chain. Deals 10% target max health damage. (Halved for bosses)
Bugfixes
The Duplicator should now properly duplicate any item.

notes.title: Vulture is arriving on September 12th!
notes.content:
Loot and Plunder
Get ready to pirate with Vulture, a ship designed to loot and destroy items with its unique Junk mechanic. Junk items are broken parts that you can acquire from multiple sources, like the Buzzsaw, which destroys enemy items that it touches and gives you a Junk item when it does.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/4a88fac87b60a73be8f7477c6645560f0afc8cb6.png"]

Junk items have several uses. On their own Junk items provide only small bonuses. However, they can also be combined with fearsome Unstable items, which destroy their adjacent items to boost their power.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/f0653f41a7e2bc058a5375cea144b7ad4290fd1f.png"]

But powerful weapons also come with their own notoriety. Some items grant great power at the cost of increasing your Wanted Level, which increases the difficulty of the battles.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/07f1c0cad3ccdf42b9ab71151d057299b32007b0.png"]

notes.title: Update 0.6.8
notes.content:
Balance Changes
Guns will prioritize ships that have Healer AI

The Nameless fight has been made easier by reducing laser prism count. It also has a new attack pattern.

Upgrading Zapwave now increases the number of bullets it releases.
Bugfixes
Fixed a reconnection bug in multiplayer.

Fixed a bug where the game wouldn't detect when another player used a modifier in multiplayer.

Fixed a softlock with the ship unlock screen.

Fixed a bug where the Nameless had 0 health on its extensions.

notes.title: Update 0.6
notes.content:
Features
The Forge is now available and can be unlocked by destroying the Coalition Flagship.

Counter Assembly now turns red in the workshop when the two weapons are not of the same rarity.

We're adding an experimental change under the hood that makes players attempt to reconnect if they disconnected in multiplayer sessions.
Balance Changes
The Anti-Regen status effect now reduces regeneration by 50% instead of 100%

All ship deployers now have a limit to how many ships they can deploy. Most enemies will have a limit of 2-3, while bosses will have more.

The instance of damage that breaks your shield will not carry over to your health.

The Nameless has a new mechanic: When one of its parts dies, it releases laser prisms in a circle.

Steelwing:

Reactant reworked: Acid damage taken is reduced by your percentage of missing health. Adjacent weapons inflict 2 Acid to yourself and enemies.

Technovirus now also heals you for the Acid damage on the enemy that dies.

Hive reworked: When you ram or use a melee weapon, deploy a Razorfly and restore 4% health.

Parasitic Injector range increased 400 -> 500

Glitch:

Override changed: If you have no guns, enemy bullets can hit their allies and have +2 bounce.

Cheap Missiles changed: Your missile weapons have +1 Multishot and they lock on to yourself.

Virtual Reaper changed: A death zone chases enemies and makes ALL bullets bounce off the inside 4 times.

Mini Missile Launcher cooldown reduced 15 -> 10

Static Cannon changed to Static Launcher: Fires missiles that explode and inflict Scramble.

Slipstream now has a visual indicator showing you when a bullet misses you (you don't need Dodge for it to activate)

Slipstream buffed: Restore 1% health each time an enemy bullet misses or bounces off of you.

Slipstream rarity reduced Epic -> Rare
Bugfixes
Fire rate, damage, and range buffs now stack additively as intended instead of multiplicatively.

Negation Barrier now interacts properly with bouncing bullets.

Fixed a bugged interaction between missiles and enemy reflection shields.

Fixed a bug where bolts had no lifesteal.

Fixed a bug where Star Fiber was not correctly reducing damage from bullets.

notes.title: Forge is arriving on August 29th!
notes.content:
Command your Fleet
The Forge is our drone ship, leading a large army of drones to destroy your enemies. It has access to a wide variety of drone types, like the Repair Drone, which can keep your fleet healthy, or the Omni Drone, which can equip any item you give it.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/dd38a69065490d70fd546e3c7d695a7927e94f64.png"]
Heavy Arsenal, Heavy Price
However, Hangars are Heavy items, which reduce your ship's speed by 10% for each one equipped. Equip too many and you won't be able to dodge incoming bullets! Fortunately, this ship comes with several ways to solve this weakness, like the Chronofield, which reduces the speed of incoming enemy bullets!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/02e623a82a4b62fa321f87a59cf9d83ffa06a181.png"]
Unrivaled Firepower
You may think this ship only utilizes drones in its arsenal, but that's not all! While your drones are out there fighting for you, you're not just a sitting duck watching the battle from afar. You can still utilize the powerful Core weapons to blast away tougher foes.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/76b8881c9f3936f63bb5f6e6b6e58b85f8af1b7a.gif"]


Glitch Changes
The Glitch has landed as our strongest ship to date, with an arsenal of wacky ways to destroy your foes. But there is no worse offender than its greatest defensive tool: Virtual Reaper. This update will change Virtual Reaper into a new item that is weaker as a defensive option but stronger as an offensive option. It is now a bubble that captures all bullets and makes them bounce around inside. Combo it with Override or your own bullets for some powerful effects!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/db6867fcfc60e8ad859afabc2b515e10f325104a.gif"]
Steelwing Revisited
Steelwing suffers from having incredibly synergy-dependent items that are weak pieces on their own but powerful when combined. In this update, we're addressing this by buffing several of its items to be more self-reliant, so the ship requires fewer pieces to get a build going. For example, the new Reactant is not only a great offensive tool, but it can also significantly reduce Acid damage taken, countering its own downside.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/77ea6d27653aff169eaeabfa003029ac0228a4a0.png"]

notes.title: Update 0.5
notes.content:
Features
Glitch has been added to the game and can be unlocked by destroying the World Eater.

The fourth difficulty level has been added to the game.

Items with specific conditions will turn red when those conditions are not met.

More Modifiers have been added to the Modifier Pool:

Legendary Gift: Get a random Legendary item from another ship.

Epic Gift: Get 2 random Epic items from another ship.

Rare Gift: Get 3 random Rare items from another ship.

Your mouse is now locked to the screen during combat.

The mouse should not take over controls while you have arrowkeys pressed during combat.

The game now runs in debug mode. If you experience a crash, please contact us (preferably on Discord) and we can try and figure out the crash from your logs.
Balance Changes
Overall difficulty has been adjusted:

Enemy fleet sizes are reduced by 25% across all difficulties.

Rare enemies are now stronger but also more rare. This makes Act 1 easier while acts 3 + 4 are harder.

The Skypiercer has had slight adjustments to items:

Nitro now affects your turn rate by default.

Nitro Lab changed: Gain 2% Shield Regen for each point of Nitro.

Pulsar Heart now destroys bullets.

Zeus changed: Melee Weapon. When this hits a Marked enemy, damage all Marked enemies.

Item Acquisition Adjustment:

In Act 1, every set of rewards is guaranteed to have at least one weapon or deployer.

In Acts after 1, every set of rewards is guaranteed to have at least one item from your class.

Advanced Controls nerfed from 6->4 dodge.

The Celestials' Triangle Missiles now die in one hit from Anti Missiles.

Asteroids now have 10x health.

Shatter Cannon bullets now have 1 bounce.

The difficulty level of the Gemini battle has been reduced.
Bugfixes
Fixed a bug where bullets that stick to enemies with multiple parts would be offset at weird positions.

Fixed a bug where players saw different items on their allies in multiplayer.

Fixed a crash caused by enemy Black Hole bullets.

Fixed a crash caused by equipping Panic Button and Laser Beam.

Fixed a visual bug with long-ranged weapon arcs.

Fixed a bug where equipping more than one Star Fiber on your ship would cause enemy bullets to restore your shield.

The Nameless minions have been temporarily disabled while we investigate a crash.

notes.title: Glitch arrives on August 15th!
notes.content:
Our next playable ship is set to be released on August 15th!
Glitch is a rule-bending hacker ship that sabotages enemies with debuffs and can even turn their own bullets against them. For example, the Override item will allow nearby enemies to be hit by their own bullets, but only if your ship has no guns equipped.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/4eca800a1d5e57072a3e828910924e6c5a6cb13e.gif"]

But you know what doesn't count as a gun? Beam weapons! The Glitch has a variety of Beam weapons to help it annihilate foes while still enjoying the benefits of various items.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/1031b857b32bbb837f8f41989ef720d45d6819db.png"]

But Beam weapons aren't your only option. The Glitch can even make use of enemy weapons in various unique ways, and has its own arsenal of missile weapons as well.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/e5bf4fafc226f3e4c6086d2aa75a520306b818ab.jpg"]You will be able to unlock our next ship starting on our August 15th update, which will also include balance changes and some new items for other ships as well, so stay tuned for more information!

notes.title: Update 0.4.0
notes.content:
Features
Two new difficulty levels have been added to the game.

Modifiers have been added to the game. Modifiers are single-use buffs that are awarded for beating bosses.

You can now shift an item in the ship customization screen by dragging another item over it.

You can now view your ship while selecting a reward.

You can now see what your next fight will be while customizing your ship or selecting a reward.
Bugfixes
Fixed a bug where Shield Shrapnel did nothing when upgraded.

Fixed a bug where enemy Triangle missiles were exploding on-fire.

Multiplayer battles should no longer spawn a massive fleet of enemies and instead spawns them as reinforcements that replace enemies that are killed.

Ships that die off-screen no longer shake your camera.
Balance Changes
Duplicator can now duplicate any item instead of just guns. The Duplicates have reduced rarity.

Metamorphosis now also copies the buffs on the melee weapon in front of it.

When a boss dies, their minions also die, ending  the fight immediately.

notes.title: Update 0.3.0
notes.content:
Steelwing has been added as a playable ship! To unlock the Steelwing, first destroy the Swarmlord.

Firestorm mini-rework
Firestorm has received some changes to some items:  

Shatter Cannon: Recoil(20). Fires bullets that explode into more bullets.  

Junk Ejector: When your weapons Recoil, spawn a Mine. Adjacent items have 20% less Recoil.  

Shock Disperser: Every 5 seconds while slowed, adjacent weapons gain +1 Multishot on their next shot.  

Impact Booster: Speed +32%. Adjacent guns have Recoil(5). 

These items will replace the following items. Some of these items have been moved to a future ship.   Double Cannon  Junk Launcher  Chronofield  Heavy Augment 
Neutral Item Pool Adjustment
We've removed some undesirable items from the neutral item pool. Some of these items will move to other ships. 

Laser Blaster  

Gatling Gun  

Shield Restorer (Moved to The Keep)  

Drill 

In addition, the Pulse Emitter has been replaced with the Shield Restorer for The Keep's item pool. 
Balance Changes
 Players can no longer be slowed below 50%  

Missile Stockpile recoil reduced from 15 -> 10  

The Devourers Chompers now have a lifespan of 5 seconds so they don't infinitely spawn and lag the game.  

Counter Assembly has been adjusted: "If the gun in front and behind this have the same Rarity, they swap bullets." 
Bugfixes
Fixed the Dino Missiles having black glow instead of red.  

Laser beam visuals should no longer stutter.  

Fixed a bug where Targeting Systems and Magnifier were not updating the arc visuals for guns.  

Added changes to prevent multiplayer desync at the end of battles where multiple enemies are being spawned.

notes.title: Steelwing arrives on July 18th!
notes.content:
A Living Weapon
The Steelwing will be joining the roster of playable ships on July 18th, bringing with it an arsenal of living weaponry and new mechanics!
Hazardous To All
The Steelwing uses an array of Acid weapons. You may have already been hit by one or two of these weapons, and now you will be able to use them yourself! Acid is a simple damage-over-time debuff that stacks indefinitely. Health bars big and small will wither away when doused with Acid.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/ec3c2ec78bc0d2ba4522184fc1d38a7e00f22f86.gif"]

But that's not all! The Steelwing can also apply Acid to itself, paying a price for significant power. But be warned! If this isn't used properly, you will find yourself a victim of your making!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/96ed4a66a06b25032cf2f2d747c0a59880007d9f.jpg"]
Do Not Touch
The Steelwing also utilizes a wide array of Melee Weapons. Get up close to cut through swaths of enemies!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/faab36690e29e9c94b99efdd5d60f35d6c6f0ddb.jpg"]
Firestorm Revisited
We've updated the Firestorm to make some of its less exciting items more exciting. The Firestorm has some cool builds and a core identity already, but it has some items that don't really fit or don't support its identity. These items have been reworked to be much more fun and interesting to build around. And don't worry! Most of the replaced items still exist, but we're planning a new home for them on an upcoming ship!
Heavy Firepower
The Firestorm utilizes the new Recoil mechanic. Certain guns with Recoil will slow your ship when they fire, but the Firestorm has ways to circumvent this downside, and can even benefit from it.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/41ab49e92f199eef623073571a1d016ce5be1477.jpg"]

For example, the Double Cannon has been replaced with the Shatter Cannon. This weapon may seem familiar to you, as it's a mainstay of the Coalition's arsenal. Now you can be the one on the delivering end of it!

We hope you'll enjoy these new items for the ship, and if you miss the replaced items, don't worry! They'll be showing up again on a future ship!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2.1
notes.content:
Hotfix 0.2.1 will provide the following fixes:

 Fixed a bug where Negation Barrier would stop working if an item of a higher rarity was equipped.
 Implemented a fix for a multiplayer desync that would occur at the end of battle.

notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
Ace arrives in style

Our new ship will become playable this patch! Ace can be unlocked by destroying the Titan.
Bugfixes

 Fixed several bugs that were causing the game to crash in multiplayer.
 Fixed a bug where duplicated Echo Guns were not properly contributing to the multishot counter.
 Optimized collision detection for improved performance.
 Optimized weapon target detection for improved performance.
 Fixed a bug where the Missile Stockpile slow effect was significantly reduced.
 Fixed a bug where Chronofield's slow effect was weaker than intended for players.
 Fixed a bug where Missile Drones equipped their Missile Launchers sideways.
 Fixed a bug where having multiple Negative Zones of the same rarity would disable them.
 Duplicator now properly highlights adjacent items.
 Fixed a bug where Targeting Systems was giving less firing arc than displayed.


Balance Changes


 You can no longer be slowed below 10% of your original speed.
 Bullet Enhancer now also boosts Orbital Slicer speed.
 Minigun replaced with Gatling Gun, which ramps fire rate over time while firing.
 Zapwave rarity changed from Common to Legendary.
 Hitlist rarity changed from Rare to Common.
 Negative Zone rarity changed from Epic to Rare.
 Scrappers Bomb health reduced 40 -> 20 and number of bullets on death reduced 12 -> 10.
 Enemy Exploding Bullet speed reduced by half.
 Shield Rerouter changed: "Slow recovery +10% per second and Shields -50%."

Features

 Ace added as a playable ship.
 Added an option to disable screen shake.
 Added an option to display your weapon firing arcs as faint cones.
 Player Missiles and Mines are now yellow to differentiate them from enemy Missiles and Mines.
 Nitro now also displays as a counter above your healthbar.

notes.title: Ace is arriving on July 4th!
notes.content:
Our next playable ship, Ace is set to be released on July 4th!
Ace is a maverick battleship that loves to be surrounded by enemies. Take Trick Shot for example. This item allows its adjacent weapons to also shoot an extra bullet backwards whenever they fire.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/4f8bb01828c34c790e7af9ceb7be7e4af1f27dd4.jpg"]
Maximum Firepower
With this update, we're also introducing two new mechanics. The Overheat status effect can be applied to enemy ships, causing them to take damage from their own weapons whenever they fire.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/839fa80eacb37ac8dcec0d1f3a8ec458ff0a2354.jpg"]

Of course, there's more to this than just a debuff. Ace also has the almighty Inferno Missiles, which stick to enemies and turn into their own weapons (which damage their allies).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/46edac01ffeee69d815f016a0277d033b33b9ae7.gif"]
High Risk, High Reward
Ace also takes advantage of the new Dodge mechanic. Dodge is a resource that you spend to ignore bullets that would normally hit you. Because of this, Ace can even afford to sacrifice shield for some extra power.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/4b6e16b4165919683a92bc3f886e8235e3ec92e8.jpg"]

You will be able to unlock our new ship starting on our July 4th update, which will also include some more significant changes and fixes, so stay tuned for more information!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.1
notes.content:
We're releasing Hotfix 0.1.1 to address a common crash that occurs in Multiplayer. This patch also experiments with an overhaul of the collision system and the Godot Compatability renderer.

You can try the Hotfix on the beta branch right now! Don't forget to let us know if you have any problems!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539996/8ebaf7ae2b61488bff2c0b8b023385afb516dd53.png"]
